provider: jsdelivr as storage for release assets

free_tier.stated: None reachable: The GitHub proxy only indexes git repo files. Release assets return 404, so the >2 GiB objects that make Releases interesting cannot be fronted by jsDelivr. They stay on GitHub's own Fastly.
free_tier.notes: the offer existed; the rejection records why it is unusable here

per_object_cap.stated: Single GitHub files larger than 20 MB are not supported by default; packages larger than 150 MB are not supported by default.
per_object_cap.notes: not applicable: a rejected offer has no per-object cap to shard

retention.stated: Fetched files are kept permanently in S3: jsDelivr will continue to serve the stored copy forever even if the upstream package is deleted.
retention.notes: Binding failure documented in record details.

egress.terms: No bandwidth limits and no premium features; it is completely free to use.

chaining: A multi-CDN CDN chaining Cloudflare and Fastly with version fallback and a combine endpoint across /gh/ and /npm/ files.
